title: English Practice Quiz 0565
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: Read: 'Mina takes the bus at 8 a.m. and reaches work at 8:45.' How does Mina travel?
questions.explanation: The passage clearly says Mina takes the bus.

questions.question: Choose the correctly written date phrase.
questions.explanation: Days of the week begin with a capital letter.

questions.question: She said, 'Please sit down.'
options: She asked me to sit down.
questions.explanation: A request can be reported with asked + object + to-infinitive.

questions.question: I ___ a new notebook yesterday.
questions.explanation: Yesterday signals the past simple. The past form of buy is bought.

questions.question: Choose the opposite of 'polite'.
questions.explanation: Rude is the opposite of polite.

questions.question: ___ I borrow your pen, please?
questions.explanation: May is a polite way to ask permission.

questions.question: How many syllables are in 'computer'?
questions.explanation: Computer is commonly pronounced with three syllables: com-pu-ter.

questions.question: Which is a complete sentence?
questions.explanation: The team finished the work contains a subject and a complete predicate.

questions.question: He asked, 'Where do you live?'
options: He asked where do I live.
He asked where did I lived.
He asked where I live do.
questions.explanation: Reported questions use statement word order; do is removed.

questions.question: They ___ ready for the meeting.
questions.explanation: Use are with the plural subject they.
